fine_lines.title: discount vs refund
fine_lines.explanation_ar: discount خصم من السعر قبل الدفع، وrefund مبلغ يُعاد إليك بعد الدفع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A discount is money off before you pay. A refund is money given back after you pay.

examples.sentence: We give a 10% discount on large orders.
The product was broken, so I got a refund.

fine_lines.title: stationery vs stationary
fine_lines.explanation_ar: stationery بحرف e = أدوات مكتبية، وstationary بحرف a = ثابت لا يتحرك. النطق واحد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Stationery (with e) = paper, pens, envelopes. Stationary (with a) = not moving. Same sound.

examples.sentence: We need to order more stationery.
The car was stationary at the lights.

expressions.phrase: What kind of price are you willing to pay?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما السعر الذي أنت مستعد لدفعه؟
expressions.meaning_en: Ask the buyer about their budget.
expressions.example: Before we talk numbers, what kind of price are you willing to pay?

expressions.phrase: I don't think we can go that low.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا أظن أننا نستطيع أن ننزل إلى هذا الحد.
expressions.meaning_en: Politely refuse a very low price.
expressions.example: £2 per unit? I'm sorry, I don't think we can go that low.

expressions.phrase: If you buy more stock, I can offer you a bigger discount.
expressions.meaning_ar: إذا اشتريت كمية أكبر يمكنني أن أقدّم لك خصمًا أكبر.
expressions.meaning_en: Link a bigger order to a better price.
expressions.example: If you buy more stock, I can offer you a bigger discount, say 15%.

expressions.meaning_en: Let's agree on a price between yours and mine.
expressions.example: OK, I'll meet you halfway: £3.50 per unit.

expressions.meaning_en: We have lots ready to sell.
expressions.example: Don't worry, we have plenty in stock.

expressions.meaning_en: Thank someone for returning your call.
expressions.example: Thanks for calling back so quickly.

expressions.meaning_en: I will help you in return one day.
expressions.example: Thanks for finishing my report. I owe you one.

grammar.title: First conditional for offers: If + present, I can/will...
grammar.explanation_ar: في التفاوض نربط عرضًا بشرط: If + مضارع بسيط، ثم can/will + فعل مجرد. If you buy more, I can offer a discount.
grammar.explanation_en: In negotiations, link an offer to a condition: If + present simple, then can/will + base verb.
examples: If you buy more stock, I can offer you a bigger discount.
If you order today, we will deliver on Monday.
If you pay now, I can give you 5% off.

grammar.title: Softening a 'no': I don't think we can...
grammar.explanation_ar: لرفض طلب بلطف نقول I don't think we can... بدلًا من No أو We can't المباشرة.
grammar.explanation_en: To refuse politely, say I don't think we can... instead of a direct No.
examples: I don't think we can go that low.
I don't think we can deliver by Friday.
I don't think we can accept that offer.

questions.question: What does "I'll meet you halfway" mean in a negotiation?
choices: Let's agree on a price in the middle
questions.explanation_ar: تعني أن نتّفق على حلّ وسط في السعر.
questions.explanation_en: It means a compromise price in the middle.

questions.question: What kind of price are you ___ to pay?
I don't think we can go that ___.
questions.explanation_ar: go that low تعني ننزل بالسعر إلى هذا الحد.
questions.explanation_en: Go that low = accept such a low price.

questions.question: If you ___ more stock, I can offer you a bigger discount.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد if في الشرط الأول نستخدم المضارع البسيط.
questions.explanation_en: After if (first conditional) use the present simple.
